<HBox spacing="20.0"> <children> <VBox styleClass="chart-container" HBox.hgrow="ALWAYS"> <children><Label text=" Répartition des rôles" style="-fx-font-size: 16px; -fx-font-weight: bold;" /><PieChart fx:id="rolePieChart" prefHeight="300.0" /></children> </VBox> <VBox styleClass="chart-container" HBox.hgrow="ALWAYS"> <children><Label text=" Statistiques des utilisateurs" style="-fx-font-size: 16px; -fx-font-weight: bold;" /><BarChart fx:id="statsBarChart" prefHeight="300.0"><xAxis><CategoryAxis label="Catégorie" /></xAxis><yAxis><NumberAxis label="Nombre" /></yAxis></BarChart></children> </VBox> </children> </HBox>

<!-- ==================== VUE COMMANDES ==================== --> <VBox fx:id="ordersView" spacing="15.0" visible="false" managed="false"> <children> <HBox spacing="15.0"> <children> <TextField fx:id="orderSearchField" promptText=" Rechercher par ID..." prefHeight="35.0" prefWidth="250.0" style="-fx-background-radius: 20; -fx-padding: 0 15;" /> <ComboBox fx:id="orderStatusFilter" prefWidth="150.0" prefHeight="35.0" promptText="Tous statuts" style="-fx-background-radius: 20;" /> </children> </HBox> <TableView fx:id="ordersTable" prefHeight="300.0" styleClass="museum-table"> <columns> <TableColumn fx:id="orderIdColumn" prefWidth="80.0" text="N°" /> <TableColumn fx:id="orderUserIdColumn" prefWidth="80.0" text="User ID" /> <TableColumn fx:id="orderDateColumn" prefWidth="150.0" text="Date" /> <TableColumn fx:id="orderTotalColumn" prefWidth="100.0" text="Total" /> <TableColumn fx:id="orderStatusColumn" prefWidth="120.0" text="Statut" /> <TableColumn fx:id="orderAddressColumn" prefWidth="200.0" text="Adresse" /> <TableColumn fx:id="orderPaymentColumn" prefWidth="120.0" text="Paiement" /> </columns> </TableView> <TitledPane text="Détails de la commande" animated="true" expanded="false"> <content> <VBox spacing="10.0" style="-fx-padding: 10;"> <children> <Label fx:id="orderDetailsLabel" text="Sélectionnez une commande" /> <ListView fx:id="orderItemsList" prefHeight="150.0" /> </children> </VBox> </content> </TitledPane> <HBox alignment="CENTER_RIGHT" spacing="10.0"> <children> <Button fx:id="confirmOrderBtn" onAction="#handleConfirmOrder" styleClass="btn-action-green" text="✅ Confirmer" /> <Button fx:id="cancelOrderBtn" onAction="#handleCancelOrder" styleClass="btn-action-outline" text="❌ Annuler" />
</children> </HBox> </children> </VBox>
</children> </VBox> <VBox fx:id="forumPanel" spacing="15.0" visible="false" managed="false" /> <VBox fx:id="jobsPanel" spacing="15.0" visible="false" managed="false" />
</children> </VBox> </content> </ScrollPane> </center> </BorderPane>
